title: Top SkillsFuture Courses and Their Impact on Employability of Participants
what_it_is: Top SkillsFuture Courses and Their Impact on Employability of Participants

sections.label: Top 10 SkillsFuture courses
sections.summary: Lists the top 10 courses in descending order, including computer, tablet, driving, food safety and cooking courses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Mr Zainal Sapari asked for the top 10 courses, so here they are in descending order. 1) Use Basic Functions and Applications of a Computer; 2) Basic Computer Course in Chinese; 3) Use Primary Functions and Applications of a Tablet; 4) Private Hire Car Driver’s Vocational Licence; 5) Use Primary Functions and Applications of a Computer; 6) Follow Food and Beverage Safety and Hygiene Policies and Procedures; 7) Tablet Fundamentals; 8) Use Basic Functions and Applications of a Computer; 9) SkillsFuture@PA Chinese Restaurant Cooking (Elementary); and 10) Beginner Workplace Literacy.

sections.label: Claims and participant outcomes
sections.summary: About 62,000 claims were made over two years, mostly by Singaporeans aged 40 and above, with job outcomes hard to ascertain.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Over the two-year period, about 62,000 claims were made by Singaporeans for these top 10 courses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Close to 90% of the participants are Singaporeans aged 40 and above.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: However, it is difficult to ascertain if the training led to better jobs or new jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: To drive those outcomes, we have specific schemes, such as the Professional Conversion Programmes (PCP), Place and Train, and Adapt and Grow where we monitor the progress of each and every trainee.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit and movement spending
sections.summary: SkillsFuture Credit costs around $40 million a year, while the entire movement and courses cost about $700 million per year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: On SkillsFuture Credit, we spend around $40 million a year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But the entire movement and all the courses, including Adapt and Grow that we support the Ministry of Manpower on, Place and Train, PCP, they cost us about $700 million per year.

sections.label: Number of courses available
sections.summary: As of the latest count, there are about 20,000 courses to choose from.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As of latest count, it is about 20,000 courses to choose from.
